calls.body: The Rangers are near the top of the league for chance quality, but the Kings are one of the best at preventing dangerous shots. We think the Kings win this one.

surprises.head: Both teams played to type
surprises.body: Nothing in this game strayed far from how these two usually play: the shot share, the quality of chances, special teams, hitting, ice time and goaltending all landed inside their normal night-to-night range.

story.head: Doughty has a goal and two assists as the Kings beat the Rangers
paras: It was a busy first period. Taylor Ward got the scoring started for the Kings a little over a minute in, in his first game of the season. Brandt Clarke stretched the lead to 2-0 less than four minutes later, but J.T. Miller got the Rangers on the board midway through the first. Drew Doughty made it 3-1 for the Kings four and a half minutes later. The Rangers pulled James Reimer after three goals and turned to Dylan Garand to start the second. Artemi Panarin stretched the lead to 4-1 on the power play early in the second, and Mikey Anderson made it 5-1 later in the period. Los Angeles had a goal taken off for goalie interference early in the period, though it didn’t end up costing them. Adam Fox cut Los Angeles’ lead to 5-2 on the power play midway through the period, in his 500th NHL game. With the goalie pulled and just under four minutes left, Tye Kartye made it 5-3. Joel Edmundson added an empty-net goal with less than four minutes left to make it 6-3. Doughty finished with a goal and two assists.
The chances were closer than the score. Darcy Kuemper made 23 saves for the Kings. The Kings moved to 3-5-2, seventh in the Pacific, while the Rangers fell to 7-6-1, second in the Metropolitan.

items.text: Drew Doughty passed Dustin Brown for seventh on the Kings’ all-time scoring list, with 713 points.
The Rangers are on a three-game losing streak.
The Kings have beaten the Rangers six straight times, going back to the 2023-24 season.
Drew Doughty scored his first goal of the season, his first since Mar 16 (24 games played since).
